tagline: 松下数码相机，2006 年发布
description: 松下于2006年推出的数码相机。配备Leica DC Vario-Elmarit 6.3-25.2mm (28-112mm equiv.) ASPH., f/2.8-4.9。快门速度Electronic shutter+Mechanical shutter。使用RAW+JPEG, JPEG。感光度100/200/400/800/1600/3200。Normal/AF Macro/Manual。

specs.镜头: Leica DC Vario-Elmarit 6.3-25.2mm (28-112mm equiv.) ASPH., f/2.8-4.9
specs.传感器: Matsushita 1/1.65" (8.50 x 4.78 mm) CCD 10Mp w/ Primary color filter
specs.曝光测光: Program AE/ Aperture-priority AE/Shutter-priority AE/Manual Exposure + Exposure Compensation (1/3 EV Step, -2 to +2 EV)
specs.闪光灯: Flash Range in ISO AUTO Aprox. 60cm (1.97 ft) to 4.9m (16.08 ft)
specs.英文简介: The Panasonic Lumix DMC-LX2 is the successor to the unique DMC-LX1, the world's first compact with a 16:9 widescreen sensor.
